description: This script is a command-line utility to start a backend server in different modes ('dev' or 'prod'). It performs preflight checks for environment variables, parses command-line arguments, and spawns an npm process to run the appropriate start script.

methods.name: usageAndExit(code)
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and exits the process with a given exit code.

methods.name: getModeFromArgs(argv)
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine the mode ('dev' or 'prod') for running the backend.

methods.name: preflightEnv()
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the critical environment variable 'DATABASE_URL' and prompts the user if missing.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the mode detection, environment check, and spawning of the backend process.
